1.name: City Patrol
1.description: Patrol city streets and maintain peace in <hex:020924E802FF0E4C696D7361204C6F6D696E7361FF0947726964616E6961FF07556C2764616803>.
1.translation_description: Pattuglia le strade cittadine e mantieni la pace a <hex:020924E802FF0E4C696D7361204C6F6D696E7361FF0947726964616E6961FF07556C2764616803>.

3.name: Outskirts Patrol
3.translation_description: Fai la ronda in una di queste zone: <hex:020939E802FF134C61204E6F736365612043656E7472616C65FF0E56656C6F2043656E7472616C65FF125468616E616C616E2043656E7472616C6503>. Elimina ogni potenziale minaccia per i viaggiatori.

5.name: Supply Wagon Escort
5.description: Escort supply wagon to <hex:020938E802FF1243616D7020536B756C6C2056616C6C6579FF13416D61726973736169782773205370697265FF0D43616D7020447279626F6E6503>. Remain alert for possible threats, and ensure supplies arrive undamaged.
5.translation_description: Scorta il carro dei rifornimenti <hex:02094AE802FF17616C2043616D706F2056616C6C65205465736368696FFF1A616C6C61204775676C696120646920416D6172697373616978FF13616C2043616D706F204F737361736563636103>. Resta in allerta per possibili minacce e assicurati che il carico arrivi integro.

7.name: Flagged Mission: Voidsent Elimination
7.translation_name: Missione segnalata: Eliminazione delle creature del Vuoto
7.description: Cabal of minor voidsent spotted in vicinity of <hex:020935E802FF14576F616420576869737065722043616E796F6EFF0B537069726974686F6C64FF104E6F706869636127732057656C6C7303>. Deploy to area and execute thorough “sweep and eliminate.”
7.translation_description: Un gruppo di creature minori del Vuoto è stato avvistato <hex:02096CE802FF2B6E6569207072657373692064656C6C6120476F6C612064656C20537573737572726F20417A7A7572726FFF1B6E65692070726573736920646920526F6363617370697269746FFF206E6569207072657373692064656920506F7A7A69206469204E6F706869636103>. Raggiungi la zona e conduci un accurato rastrellamento per eliminare la minaccia.

9.name: Officer Escort
9.description: High-ranking <hex:02091AE802FF0873657270656E74FF06666C616D65FF0673746F726D03> officer to visit city to plan Alliance strategies. Meet said officer at airship landing, and serve as personal guard for visit duration.
9.translation_description: Un ufficiale di alto rango <hex:02094FE802FF2364656C6CE280994F7264696E652064656C6C61205669706572612047656D656C6C61FF1764656C6C65204669616D6D6520496D6D6F7274616C69FF0F64656C6C612054656D706573746103> visiterà la città per pianificare le strategie dell’Alleanza. Accoglilo all’aeroporto e proteggilo per tutta la visita.

11.name: Stronghold Recon
11.description: Reconnoiter the <hex:02093BE802FF0B4B6F626F6C6420446967FF164978616C69206C6F6767696E672067726F756E6473FF14416D616C6A27616120656E63616D706D656E7403> and assess enemy forces. Avoid engagements when possible, but mission completion takes priority.
11.translation_description: Esplora <hex:02095AE802FF154C6F20536361766F2064656920436F626F6C6469FF1D6C652061726565206469207461676C696F206465676C69204978616CFF226CE28099616363616D70616D656E746F206465676C6920416D616C6AE28099616103> e valuta le forze nemiche. Evita gli scontri quando possibile, ma porta a termine la missione a ogni costo.

12.name: Search and Rescue
12.description: Contact lost with unit deployed in enemy-controlled region of <hex:020939E802FF106F75746572204C61204E6F73636561FF11746865204E6F727468205368726F7564FF126E6F72746865726E205468616E616C616E03>. Locate missing unit, and evacuate surviving members.
12.translation_description: Si sono persi i contatti con un’unità schierata in una regione nemica: <hex:020944E802FF124C61204E6F736365612045737465726E61FF1456656C6F2053657474656E7472696F6E616C65FF185468616E616C616E2053657474656E7472696F6E616C6503>. Trova i dispersi ed evacua i superstiti.

14.name: Flagged Mission: Crystal Recovery
14.description: A joint operation is planned to prevent summoning of <hex:020919E802FF06546974616EFF07476172756461FF06496672697403> by forces entrenched in the <hex:02093BE802FF0B4B6F626F6C6420446967FF164978616C69206C6F6767696E672067726F756E6473FF14416D616C6A27616120656E63616D706D656E7403>. Cooperate with allies to infiltrate stronghold and seize cache of ritual crystals.
14.translation_description: È in programma un’operazione congiunta per impedire che le forze asserragliate <hex:020961E802FF17616C6C6F20536361766F2064656920436F626F6C6469FF206E656C6C652061726565206469207461676C696F206465676C69204978616CFF24616C6CE28099616363616D70616D656E746F206465676C6920416D616C6AE28099616103> evochino <hex:020919E802FF06546974616EFF07476172756461FF06496672697403>. Collabora con gli alleati per infiltrarti nella roccaforte e recuperare i cristalli rituali.

15.name: Flagged Mission: Crystal Recovery
15.description: A joint operation is planned to prevent summoning of <hex:020919E802FF06546974616EFF07476172756461FF06496672697403> by forces entrenched in the <hex:02093BE802FF0B4B6F626F6C6420446967FF164978616C69206C6F6767696E672067726F756E6473FF14416D616C6A27616120656E63616D706D656E7403>. Cooperate with allies to infiltrate stronghold and seize cache of ritual crystals.
15.translation_description: È in programma un’operazione congiunta per impedire che le forze asserragliate <hex:020961E802FF17616C6C6F20536361766F2064656920436F626F6C6469FF206E656C6C652061726565206469207461676C696F206465676C69204978616CFF24616C6CE28099616363616D70616D656E746F206465676C6920416D616C6AE28099616103> evochino <hex:020919E802FF06546974616EFF07476172756461FF06496672697403>. Collabora con gli alleati per infiltrarti nella roccaforte e recuperare i cristalli rituali.

16.name: Stronghold Assault
16.description: Rendezvous with Allied forces and join multi-pronged assault on <hex:02092BE802FF147468652055274768616D61726F204D696E6573FF084E6174616C616EFF095A6168617227616B03>.
16.translation_description: Raggiungi le forze alleate e partecipa a un assalto coordinato <hex:020937E802FF1C616C6C65204D696E696572652064692055E280994768616D61726FFF0A61204E6174616C616EFF0B61205A6168617227616B03>.

17.name: Black Market Crackdown
17.description: Plans for sale of black market weapons uncovered by intelligence. Deploy to coordinates provided, and apprehend all involved in deal.
17.translation_description: L’intelligence ha scoperto un piano per vendere armi al mercato nero. Raggiungi le coordinate indicate e arresta tutti i coinvolti.

18.name: Imperial Recon
18.description: Reconnoiter <hex:020939E802FF114361737472756D204F63636964656E73FF0F4361737472756D2043656E747269FF134361737472756D204D6572696469616E756D03> garrison and report on enemy numbers and activity.
18.translation_description: Esplora la guarnigione di <hex:020939E802FF114361737472756D204F63636964656E73FF0F4361737472756D2043656E747269FF134361737472756D204D6572696469616E756D03> e valuta consistenza e attività delle forze nemiche. Se possibile, evita gli scontri.

19.name: Imperial Pursuit
19.description: Man described as possible imperial deserter spotted in <hex:02093AE802FF126561737465726E204C61204E6F73636561FF107468652045617374205368726F7564FF126E6F72746865726E205468616E616C616E03>. Locate suspect and bring in for interrogation.
19.translation_description: Le segnalazioni indicano un possibile disertore imperiale <hex:02094CE802FF17696E204C61204E6F73636561204F7269656E74616C65FF136E656C2056656C6F204F7269656E74616C65FF1C6E656C205468616E616C616E2053657474656E7472696F6E616C6503>. Rintraccia il sospetto e catturalo per interrogarlo.

20.name: Imperial Feint
20.description: Participate in allied mobilization against imperial forces in Mor Dhona. Ensure vital feint operation succeeds.
20.translation_description: Partecipa alla mobilitazione degli alleati contro le forze imperiali a Mor Dhona e assicurati che la manovra diversiva riesca.

22.name: Criminal Pursuit
22.description: Dangerous criminal wanted by the <hex:020938E802FF10496D6D6F7274616C20466C616D6573FF0A4D61656C7374726F6DFF184F72646572206F6620746865205477696E20416464657203> reported fleeing into <hex:02092AE802FF0A4C61204E6F73636561FF1174686520426C61636B205368726F7564FF095468616E616C616E03>. Coordinate with <hex:02091AE802FF06666C616D65FF0673746F726DFF0873657270656E7403> officer in charge of case and assist with pursuit.

23.name: Supply Wagon Destruction
23.description: Use imperial delivery schedule obtained by intelligence to locate and destroy Garlean supply wagon en route to <hex:020939E802FF114361737472756D204F63636964656E73FF0F4361737472756D2043656E747269FF134361737472756D204D6572696469616E756D03>.
23.translation_description: Usa il programma di consegne imperiali recuperato dall’intelligence per individuare e distruggere un carro dei rifornimenti garleano diretto <hex:020942E802FF14616C204361737472756D204F63636964656E73FF12616C204361737472756D2043656E747269FF16616C204361737472756D204D6572696469616E756D03>.

25.name: Primal Recon
25.description: A joint operation is planned with the Scions of the Seventh Dawn to reconnoiter the <hex:02091BE802FF076B6F626F6C64FF054978616CFF09416D616C6A27616103> for signs of summoning. Rendezvous with <hex:020921E802FF09536C616673777973FF0A44617269757374656CFF08416C69616E6E6503> and do as our allies bid.
25.translation_description: È in programma un’operazione congiunta con gli Eredi della Settima Alba per esplorare i territori <hex:02092CE802FF0C64656920436F626F6C6469FF0B6465676C69204978616CFF0F6465676C6920416D616C6A27616103> in cerca di segni di evocazione. Incontra <hex:020921E802FF09536C616673777973FF0A44617269757374656CFF08416C69616E6E6503> e segui le indicazioni dei nostri alleati.

26.name: Counter-magitek Exercises
26.description: Training exercises are scheduled incorporating captured magitek weaponry. We are invited to participate and contribute to the development of counter-magitek tactics.
26.translation_description: Sono in programma esercitazioni con armi magitek catturate. Partecipa e contribuisci allo sviluppo di tattiche per contrastare la magitek.

27.name: Infiltrate and Rescue
27.description: Civilians have been abducted by <hex:020932E802FF147468652053657270656E742052656176657273FF09746865204978616CFF0F74686520466C616D6566616E677303>. Infiltrate the enemy stronghold and liberate the captives before they are turned into thralls.
27.translation_description: È stato segnalato il rapimento di civili da parte di <hex:020938E802FF176920507265646F6E692064656C6C6120566970657261FF09676C69204978616CFF126C65205A616E6E652064692046756F636F03>. Infiltrati nella roccaforte nemica e libera i prigionieri prima che vengano asserviti.

28.name: Outlaw Subjugation
28.description: Outlaws believed to be a splinter faction of the <hex:02092BE802FF0A4D616D6F6F6C204A61FF0C436F6575726C636C617773FF0F436F72707365204272696761646503> have grown into an unacceptable threat. Find and summarily eliminate them.
28.translation_description: Una banda di fuorilegge, ritenuta una fazione dissidente <hex:02093FE802FF0E646569204D616D6F6F6C204A61FF1064656920436F6575726C636C617773FF1B64656C6C6120427269676174612064656920436164617665726903>, è diventata una minaccia intollerabile. Trovala ed eliminala senza indugio.

29.name: Cult Crackdown
29.description: The Lambs of Dalamud are engaging in illegal recruitment in <hex:020924E802FF0E4C696D7361204C6F6D696E7361FF0947726964616E6961FF07556C2764616803>. Under the guise of civilians, make contact with the cultists and bring their activities to light.
29.translation_description: Gli Agnelli di Dalamud stanno reclutando illegalmente a <hex:020924E802FF0E4C696D7361204C6F6D696E7361FF0947726964616E6961FF07556C2764616803>. Avvicinati ai cultisti sotto le mentite spoglie di un civile e fai emergere le loro attività.

30.name: Voidsent Elimination
30.translation_description: È stata segnalata la presenza di <hex:020952E802FF16756E6120737563637562652064656C2056756F746FFF19756E206D656E65737472656C6C6F2064656C2056756F746FFF1D6C612063726561747572612064656C2056756F746F20416E6368616703> nelle vicinanze. Dai la caccia alla creatura prima che faccia del male ai civili.

31.name: Armor Annihilation
31.description: An abandoned suit of magitek armor has run amok. Hasten to the site and coordinate with the officer in charge to destroy the machine.
31.translation_description: Un’armatura magitek abbandonata è impazzita. Raggiungi il luogo e collabora con l’ufficiale responsabile per distruggerla.

32.name: Invasive Testing
32.description: Brazen minions of the Illuminati are field-testing weaponry on sovereign soil. Confront them and put an end to the unsanctioned experiment.
32.translation_description: Gli sgherri degli Illuminati stanno collaudando armi sul nostro territorio con sfacciata arroganza. Affrontali e poni fine a questi esperimenti non autorizzati.

33.name: Impostor Alert
33.description: A brutish man has been terrorizing citizens while masquerading as a serpent sergeant. For the honor of the Alliance, locate and apprehend the impostor.
33.translation_description: Un uomo minaccia i cittadini fingendosi un sergente della Vipera. Per l’onore dell’Alleanza, trovalo e arresta l’impostore.

34.name: Flagged Mission: Sapper Strike
34.description: Intelligence reports imperial sappers in <hex:02093AE802FF126561737465726E204C61204E6F73636561FF107468652045617374205368726F7564FF126E6F72746865726E205468616E616C616E03>, en route to destroy city fortifications. Deploy to the area, and eliminate the enemy unit.
34.translation_description: L’intelligence segnala genieri imperiali nella zona di <hex:020941E802FF144C61204E6F73636561204F7269656E74616C65FF0F56656C6F204F7269656E74616C65FF185468616E616C616E2053657474656E7472696F6E616C6503>, diretti a distruggere le fortificazioni cittadine. Raggiungi l’area ed elimina l’unità nemica.
